item.title: Western Kentucky welcomes data centers in hopes they make up for coal losses
item.description: In Kentucky's former coal country, data centers are a welcome sight as people hope they will bring in money.

item.title: Federal authorities investigate cause of deadly plane crash in Florida
item.description: Nine people were killed Sunday when a Learjet crashed in South Florida. Federal authorities are investigating the cause of the crash that occurred during bad weather.

item.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
item.description: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.
